steps.title: Tube
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as tripod_leg.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XY Plane: a line from (205, 10) to (70, 914), the leg centre line (it leans in 8.5 degrees). Finish Sketch.
Sketch circles diameter 33.7 and 29.7 on a plane square to the line. Sweep along the line. Cut both ends level (Extrude Cut with a horizontal sketch).
steps.note: The origin is the middle of the foot, on the deck plate.

steps.title: Foot plate
actions: Sketch a 54 x 92 rectangle under the tube. Extrude 10 mm, Join (welded).

steps.title: Bolt holes
actions: Hole diameter 13 Through All, 34 mm either side of the tube. Save.
steps.note: Two M12 bolts hold each foot to the deck plate.
